all_quotes.loc: abstract
all_quotes.quote: We find that the scale lengths in the Cosmic Snake are about $\SI{0.5}{kpc}-\SI{1.5}{kpc}$, and they are 3 to 10 times larger in A521. This is a significant difference knowing that the two galaxies have comparable integrated properties.

all_quotes.loc: Conclusions
all_quotes.quote: The Cosmic Snake lies at the short end of the local scale length distribution, whereas A521 is at the long end of the local scale length distribution.

all_quotes.loc: Morphological parameters of the Cosmic Snake and A521
all_quotes.quote: Both the Cosmic Snake and A521 satisfy the relation between $\mu_\star^{\mathrm{HLR}}$ and $M_\star$ defined empirically by the distribution of local galaxies (cite: kauffmann_dependence_2003; gonzalez_delgado_califa_2015).
